rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: high street (pilot), Amber spine, arterials - trees in wells on the shop side, palms alternating on Amber: the avenue's signature (zone 406 -> about 360)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The block's four builder palms on the green at its Amber end all come back on their own spots: the avenue's palms, mixed canary date, fan and queen, 14-24 m apart. REWRITTEN by hand 21 Nov 2026 for HOTEL BEL (Yasin: "get to work on ... hotel bel"): the hotel stands on the green, so its four palms (two would stand inside the hotel, two on its terrace) give way to the hotel's own: a fan palm in the lawn strip on Amber at its north end, two Canary date palms framing the crown tower on the Ocean Blvd promenade, a queen palm on the motor court's island. Four, as before: the plan's in-view limit (12 within 60 m) is reached here with four (seven gave 15).

trees.why: Amber, the lawn strip in front of the hotel's north end: a fan palm, the avenue's palms go on past the cinema
the motor court's island (mulch bed): a queen palm the cars turn round under the porte-cochere
the Ocean Blvd promenade, in its bed: a big Canary date palm framing the hotel's corner toward the beach
the promenade's other bed: the second Canary date palm, the pair frames the crown tower and the ocean veranda
